articles.title: Hackers obtain counterfeit TLS certificates for Google and other large services
articles.content: Compromise of 3 domain registries allows hackers to walk off with unauthorized certs.

articles.title: Anthropic launches free AI security scans for open-source projects
articles.content: Anthropic's offering to help open-source projects track down security vulnerabilities with a new service called OSS Scanner. It says open-source projects that opt-in will get "thorough, periodic security scans by our strongest models at no cost."
